theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pc_straightening_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (Ψ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)), (∀ q, IsOpen (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Ψ q) (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, InjOn (Ψ q) (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, ∀ w ∈ B q, Bijective (fderiv ℝ (Ψ q) w)) ∧ (∀ q, ∀ w ∈ B q, F (Ψ q w) = w 0) ∧ (∀ q, IsOpen (Ψ q '' B q)) ∧ {y | fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ q, Ψ q '' B q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
